summary: **Summary:** BofA's AI bubble warning (citing 1990s fiber-optic parallels) triggered a $260B+ risk-off selloff, crushing high-multiple and crypto-adjacent names including PLTR, MSTR (-9.6%), MARA (-9.6%), and SNOW (-8.4%), with CoreWeave credit stress amplifying contagion fears and dragging QQQ ~2.5% lower. Middle East escalation (Yemen strikes, Saudi intercepts) and a 17M-barrel US SPR solicitation drove decisive safe-haven rotation into Defense (RTX +3.7%, LMT +3.6%) and Energy (CVX +2.6%), while AAPL held green on iPhone demand, China's $37B subsidy tailwind, and Berkshire support. All five signals remain intact — BUY on RTX, LMT, and AAPL; SELL on PLTR and MSTR.
